summary: InTest Corporation filed an 8-K reporting Q1 2026 financial results and a Seventh Amendment to its credit agreement with M&T Bank. The amendment extends the term loan draw period to August 28, 2026, and removes inTEST Silicon Valley Corporation as a guarantor. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is disclosed. The filing is a routine update on earnings and a credit facility modification, not a transformative corporate transaction. Accordingly, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
